title: T017 audit writer passed exact-head proof and awaits human review
summary: T017 runs as a separate append-only audit lane from main 63e6ea3. The tests-first baseline was confirmed red only for missing audit runtime symbols; the bounded sanitized INSERT-only implementation now passes exact-head CI/Security #173 and remains an unmerged draft until independent security/privacy review.

claims.text: T013 provides an audit_event table whose application role may insert/read but may not update/delete/truncate.
The T017 tests-first baseline fails at compileTestJava only because the audit runtime symbols are absent.
Before the final receipt, the T017 runtime implementation was awaiting exact-head Java/Testcontainers and Security proof.
The bounded T017 implementation passes exact-head CI/Security #174, including Java quality, Testcontainers, CodeQL, dependency audit and Trivy lanes.
Independent security/privacy review and protected merge approval remain pending; production activation is not authorized.

decision.context: T017 is parallel after T013 and must not inherit the unmerged T016 branch.
decision.chosen: Implement a sanitized INSERT-only JDBC writer with no schema or production activation changes.
alternatives: Add audit schema changes in T017
decision.invalidation: Re-evaluate if the T013 audit_event contract or protected database grants change.
